concept: D — B 的構圖搭配 C 的深藍色調
purpose: 封面方向討論用模擬圖
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one flat front-cover mockup for the Traditional Chinese history ebook "美國的誕生".
Primary request: keep concept B's composition and apply concept C's deep-navy palette. Create exactly one polished portrait cover, 3:4 aspect ratio, full bleed, no scene, perspective, spine or book-object mockup.

Input images:
1. EDIT TARGET / COMPOSITION MASTER: B-editorial-collage.png. Its layout must be preserved.
2. COLOR AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY: C-navy-collection.png. Borrow midnight navy, warm ivory, restrained red, subtle grain; do not borrow its centered layout or border.
3. HISTORICAL MAP REFERENCE: the original 1783 map for geography and engraving details.
4. HISTORICAL FLAG REFERENCE: thirteen-star 1777–1795 flag for accurate star arrangement.

INVARIANTS FROM IMAGE 1:
Keep the giant flush-left title in the upper approximately 40% of the cover, with exactly two lines, "美國的" and "誕生". Keep the title's dramatic scale and original position, refined high-contrast Ming/Song serif forms. Keep the smaller left-aligned author line "藍弋丰" beneath it. Keep the slanted red divider rising from left to right below the author. Keep the lower-half torn-paper collage in exactly the same broad geometry: oversized flag fragment at lower left, historical eastern-US map sheet at lower right, with the rough diagonal ripped seam running from the upper middle toward the lower middle. Preserve the energetic, asymmetric editorial composition and roomy upper-right negative space.

CHANGE THE PALETTE:
Change the entire upper title field from ivory to deep midnight navy, close to image 2. Title and author become warm pale ivory with clean strong contrast. Keep the slanted red divider as a muted brick/vermilion accent, with a thin ragged ivory paper edge. The lower-right map sheet becomes navy with fine warm-ivory engraved linework, like image 2, preserving the authentic coastline and map detail from image 3. The map remains recognizably a separate torn sheet through a slender exposed ivory ripped-paper edge and slightly lighter navy than the title area. Keep the lower-left flag's large dusty-red and ivory stripes and dark blue canton with pale stars; it must remain vivid and legible against the navy cover. Use the actual thirteen-star layout from image 4; some stars can naturally be hidden by the map overlap. Let navy dominate about two thirds of the overall image, ivory type and cartography supply light, and red provide focused accents.
Texture: subtle matte ink and fine paper/cloth grain, controlled and elegant, no heavy artificial ageing. Warm ivory should read ivory, not metallic gold.
Typography verbatim: "美國的誕生"; "藍弋丰". The final author character is 丰, NOT 豐. No new text or subtitle, no dates, no English title.
Map geography: do not duplicate or invent the Great Lakes; where labels are visible use the original historical map, especially Lake Ontario is not Lake Superior.
Avoid: centered title, decorative outer frame, small flag badge, extra imagery, modern fifty-star flag, badges, seals, eagles, watermark, glossy 3D lighting.
This is an iteration of B with C's colors, not a new composition.
